subject: Request: Custom SLA exhibit & order-form language for VitaCare enterprise MSA
messages:
From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@vitacare.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vitacare.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SLA exhibit and order-form language for enterprise MSA

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well. As we prepare to move forward under the VitaCare enterprise MSA, procurement has asked us to get a formal SLA exhibit and order-form language that capture the following: uptime commitment for the hosted inference endpoints, P95 latency targets for text-gen and embeddings, an incident escalation matrix, and evidence we can use for internal compliance (uptime history, incident runbooks, and on-call contact details).

Attached is a short questionnaire the legal/procurement team filled out (VitaCare_MSA_Questions.xlsx). High level asks from their side:
- Uptime percentage target (monthly) and credits approach for breaches
- Latency SLOs (P95 for typical gen payloads; P99 for embeddings if available)
- Data-retention & audit log retention windows for call traces and access logs
- Support hours and severity response times (they asked for 24/7 for Sev1)

Can you share an SLA addendum draft and suggested order-form snippet we can include in the PO? If you can also indicate what evidence you can provide (reports, exports, SOC references), that’ll speed procurement sign-off.

We’re hoping to get a draft back by EOD Tuesday so our legal can review. If easier, happy to schedule a 30-min sync early next week.

Thanks,
Maria Sanchez
Head of Procurement
VitaCare Systems
Attachment: VitaCare_MSA_Questions.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@vitacare.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA exhibit and order-form language for enterprise MSA

Hi Maria — thanks for the questionnaire and for outlining the asks.

Quick summary of what we can provide and next steps:
- We’ll produce a draft SLA exhibit with uptime %, latency SLO examples (P95 gen / P99 embed), and a credits table tied to monthly availability.
- We can include an incident escalation matrix and a contact for 24/7 Sev1 (our on-call rotations + dedicated CS escalation).
- Evidence: monthly uptime reports (CSV), incident summaries, and a playbook excerpt we can share under NDA. SOC-2 Type II report is available upon executed order-form / standard NDA.

I’ve looped in Ben (account exec) to confirm commercial language in the order form and Lauren from Legal for redlines. Ben — can you prepare an order-form snippet with the committed throughput tier and pricing impact for the higher SLA? Lauren — can you take a pass at the credit formula and any required MSA cross-references?

If helpful we can do a 30-min call Wednesday 8/18 09:00-09:30 PT to run through the draft. Please confirm availability.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SLA exhibit and order-form language for enterprise MSA

Looping David (CS) to capture operational evidence and confirmation on runbook excerpts.

Attachments I’m adding for internal review: proposed_SLA_exhibit_v1.docx, orderform_snippet.txt

Internal notes (Ben):
- Proposed uptime: 99.95% monthly for hosted API tier; fallbacks to lower-tier model if capacity constrained with a clearly stated fallback policy.
- Latency: commitment to P95 <= 350ms for text-gen (small prompt typical), P99 <= 220ms for 768-dim embeddings on dedicated capacity; hosted tiers include best-effort latencies with target examples.
- Credits: linear credit scale starting at 99.9 -> 5% credit, 99.5 -> 15%, <99.0 -> 30% of monthly service fees for the endpoint.

David — can you confirm we can produce monthly uptime CSVs and a redacted incident summary that meets VitaCare’s compliance team needs? Also confirm the on-call escalation contact (we propose escalation to CS manager + on-call infra lead).

Thanks,
Ben
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SLA exhibit and order-form language for enterprise MSA

Ben / Neha — confirmed. We can provide:
- Monthly uptime reports in CSV (timestamped checks + incident windows) for the past 12 months.
- Redacted incident summaries with RCA and mitigation steps, plus a one-page runbook excerpt describing detection and mitigation for service availability incidents.
- On-call escalation: CS Manager (david_kim@redwood.com) -> Infra on-call lead (infra-oc@redwood.com) -> Head of Ops (ops-head@redwood.com). We’ll include phone numbers in the exhibit for Sev1 only.

One ask from Ops: VitaCare to agree to a scheduled maintenance window (up to 4 hours/month) excluded from uptime calculations and an expected 48-hour advance notice for non-emergency maints. That should be called out in the exhibit.

I’ve reviewed Ben’s proposed credit bands — they look reasonable from an ops perspective.

-David
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@vitacare.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, procurement@vitacare.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA exhibit and order-form language for enterprise MSA

Hi Maria — thanks for the patience. Attached is a consolidated draft: VitaCare_SLA_Addendum_v1.docx. Highlights and next steps below:

What we’ve proposed (summary):
- Availability: 99.95% monthly for the selected Hosted Dedicated tier; scheduled maint (<=4 hrs/month) excluded with 48-hr notice.
- Latency targets: example commitments in exhibit (P95 text-gen <= 350ms; P99 embeddings <= 220ms) with a clause that targets are measured on representative payloads and may vary by model/sequence length.
- Credits: tiered credits table — 99.9-99.95 = 5% credit; 99.5-99.9 = 15%; <99.5 = 30% of monthly endpoint fees.
- Escalation & evidence: monthly uptime CSVs, redacted incident summaries, runbook excerpt (attached). SOC-2 Type II available after executed PO/NDA.
- Support: 24/7 Sev1 contact (CS Manager + Infra on-call lead listed in exhibit).

Next steps:
1) Review the attached addendum and orderform_snippet.txt (we included the order form language showing the committed tier and fees).
2) Please propose any redlines by EOD Friday 8/20 so we can get Legal aligned.
3) We’ll issue a DocuSign envelope once you confirm the language; link will include the exhibit as an attachment.

Attachments: VitaCare_SLA_Addendum_v1.docx, orderform_snippet.txt

If you prefer to walk through the exhibit, we can still do the short sync tomorrow at 9:00 PT.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
